rationale: Parent (Round 3 kept state) sits at the Pareto frontier: accuracy 0.9807 (0.003 slack above 0.978 floor), latency 12112ms (equals best-so-far), cost $0.002324/row (equals best-so-far). To clear the gate on any objective I'd need: accuracy>0.988 (parent 0.9807; GPT-6-Luna@medium peaked at 0.983, so unreachable without a model+reasoning combo that blows both latency and cost ceilings), OR latency<11112ms (reasoning_effort already 'none' — no further reasoning-tokens to cut; input tokens tied to fixed production schema; output tokens scale with transaction count), OR cost<$0.002024 (same output-token floor; swapping to cheaper models requires input_mode='text' which Round 4 already proved drops aggregate to 0.954, −0.029 below the floor). Compound alternatives (text+PDF split by page, GPT-5.6 fallback) either violate the once-per-document rule, add parallelism code with high row-breakage risk, or regress accuracy (card-art fields need native-PDF). The three preceding kept rounds (reasoning medium→low→none) already captured the full reasoning-tokens savings monotone; there is no remaining knob with predicted Δ>epsilon on any axis without an epsilon-breaking regression on another. A thoughtful noop preserves the frontier rather than ship a mutation whose own rationale cannot clear the gate math.
